title: The elevator almost got me again!
content: I hate the elevators in these dreams. Last night, I was either in a mall or hotel near an elevator. The door opens. There's a man inside and a phone on the elevator wall is ringing. I feel like I'm supposed to answer it. When I pick it up, it's silent, but it sounds so loud and real, if that makes sense. Then the floor of the elevator opens like a trap door and the non-descript man in there falls down. I quickly saved myself by spreading out my legs and arms to hold onto the walls. I then immediately wake up. This is the second time I've had a creepy elevator dream that suddenly woke me up.
